recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if FM raises a new issue saying the current Party responsible for reimbursement or Fee, charge or cost per item wording is semantically wrong, rather than merely different from the 2018 request wording.
issue_request: FHIR-17932 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request for ClaimResponse short descriptions. It asked to replace ClaimResponse.insurer target-style wording with insurer/adjudication wording and to replace point wording in ClaimResponse.addItem.unitPrice, ClaimResponse.addItem.detail.unitPrice, and ClaimResponse.addItem.detail.subDetail.unitPrice with unit-oriented wording.
initial_application: The 2018 FM batch commit afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a explicitly lists FHIR-17932 and changes the ClaimResponse spreadsheet rows to the current semantics: insurer as the party responsible for reimbursement/authorization/adjudication, and the affected unitPrice shorts as fee/charge/cost per item with requirements for a single unit.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, and the old spreadsheet source was imported into the current StructureDefinition source by the 2021 new-build-core rework. Published R4 and R5 profiles match the current source for the checked elements, and no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already removes Target/point wording and conveys the approved adjudicating-insurer and single-unit-price semantics through the current short, definition, and requirements text.
